title.zh: 面包板项目：接出呼叫灯
title.en: Breadboard Project · Wire the Call Light

brief.zh: 把开关灯的面包板接到 Arduino 上，让按钮把信号送给 D2，让 D13 控制电阻和外接 LED。运行呼叫灯程序，看按下和松开时灯会怎样。
brief.en: Connect your button-light breadboard to the Arduino. Let the button send its signal to D2 and use D13 to drive the resistor and external LED. Run the call-light sketch and test the light with the button pressed and released.

concept.zh: 让同一段程序读取接好的按钮，驱动外接 LED
concept.en: Use the same sketch to read a wired button and drive an external LED

hints.zh: 灯亮时选直流电压档，把红表笔放在 LED 的 A 端、黑表笔放在 K 端，读一读电压。交换两支表笔的位置，再看看数字的正负。
hints.en: While the lamp is lit, select DC volts. Put the red probe on the LED's A leg and black on K. Read the voltage, then swap the probes and check the sign.

hints.zh: 程序用 D2 读取按钮。它有内部上拉电阻，松开时读 HIGH，按下时需要一条通往 GND 的路。
hints.en: The sketch reads the button on D2. Its internal pull-up gives HIGH when released. Pressing the button should make a path to GND.

hints.zh: 在这块 Uno 上，LED_BUILTIN 对应 D13。它能给外接 LED 提供输出。检查电阻是否和 LED 串联，LED 的两端方向是否正确。
hints.en: On this Uno, LED_BUILTIN is D13. It can drive your external LED. Check that the resistor is in series with the LED and that the LED faces the right way.

hints.zh: 记住按下按钮时的 D13 读数和灯光，再翻转 LED，重新运行。哪一个变了？如果只把一只脚换到同一编号的另一个孔呢？
hints.en: Note D13 and the light when you press the button. Flip the LED and run the sketch again. What changed? What if you move a leg to another hole on the same strip?
